Title: Deployment for Azure MySQL, Kubernetes Helm, and Ruby - VSTS Sprint 133 Update

Body.Content:
The Sprint 133 Update of Visual Studio Team Services (VSTS) expands on the languages and platforms we support for build and release with VSTS. Whether your application uses Azure Database for MySQL, Kubernetes, or Ruby on Rails, we’ve got you covered. The list also keeps growing in Azure DevOps Projects. It’s never been easier to get started on a Go or Ruby application in Azure.

A new notification type and better support for NuGet upstream sources are also now available in Package Management.

For more information, see the full release notes.
